Message:

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: sam123ben
Message:
feat(security): harden api/preview/runtime + overhaul dashboards

Backend (behavior-neutral; auth gates dormant until DEVAI_REQUIRE_AUTH=true):
- require_principal helper + per-route auth gates across pipeline/scm/
  onboarding/preview/authoring/dashboard; fail-closed forwarded-header trust
- auth-bff proxy stamps X-Auth-Bff-Secret
- preview: ownership/IDOR checks, idle-TTL reaper, git-clone injection
  hardening, credential scrub from the shared PVC, generic error surfacing
- runtime: image allowlist for authored stages, RESULT payload validation,
  DevaiRuntimeError rename; mcphub SSRF allowlist + auth gate (flag-gated)
- providers fetch keys via the secrets adapter, not a gcloud shell-out
- redaction masks provider-key prefixes before chat/webhook echo
- authoring: legacy_python_class allowlist, quotas, condition-key validation

Dashboards (ALM + SRE):
- IA: /workflows is the lifecycle home, Kanban -> /board, new /runs index,
  dead routes removed; breadcrumbs + in-context guidance for workflows,
  dynamic workflows and previews
- live blueprint DAG with inline gates, blueprint picker, preview build-state
- CSP headers, login open-redirect guard, sanitized chat markdown
- Dockerfiles use npm ci + lockfile + .dockerignore; CI pins/gates Trivy
